plain: What is left over after the rest is removed

webster.text: Residue; that which is left after any process of separation or purification.

example.quote: There is another advantage; the residuum of power, as to appointments, which the president and council need possess, is less than that the president and senate must have.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XIII, Jan. 14, 1788
